rows.grounds: proper name of Viṣṇu; compound śrī+nivāsa (abode-of-Śrī), used as deity name in this Vaiṣṇava context
compound mahā+vidyā; in tantric usage denotes a great mantra/knowledge, object of receiving
compound ācārya+vadana+aṃvuja with ablative sense (-āt); indicates source as the teacher's lotus-like face/mouth
